item.title: OpenAI cuts API prices for GPT-5 mini
item.description: OpenAI announced a 50% price reduction for GPT-5 mini input tokens in the API, effective immediately for all prepaid and monthly billing accounts.

item.title: New fine-tuning recipes for structured outputs
item.description: The API now ships official fine-tuning recipes for structured outputs so teams can keep JSON schemas stable across model upgrades.
